from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls

# 1. Dict with tool_calls key -> returned as-is
r = ToolCalls.validate_input({'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]})
print('1. dict with tool_calls:', r)
assert r == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}

# 2. Single object without tool_calls key -> wrapped
r = ToolCalls.validate_input({'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}})
print('2. single object:', r)
assert r == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}

# 3. Bare list of objects -> wrapped
r = ToolCalls.validate_input([{'name': 'foo', 'args': {}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'b': 2}}])
print('3. bare list:', r)
assert r == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'b': 2}}]}

# 4. Plain JSON string (single object) -> parsed + normalized
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"a\": 1}}')
print('4. json string single:', r)
assert r == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}

# 5. Plain JSON string (bare list) -> parsed + normalized
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('[{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {}}]')
print('5. json string list:', r)
assert r == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {}}]}

# 6. Plain JSON string (dict with tool_calls) -> parsed + as-is
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('{\"tool_calls\": [{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {}}]}')
print('6. json string with tool_calls:', r)
assert r == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {}}]}

# 7. Non-JSON string -> returned unchanged
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('this is not json')
print('7. non-json string:', repr(r))
assert r == 'this is not json'

# 8. Construction path: ToolCalls(single_object)
tc = ToolCalls({'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}})
print('8. constructed from single object:', tc)
assert tc.tool_calls[0].name == 'foo'
assert tc.tool_calls[0].args == {'a': 1}

# 9. Construction path: ToolCalls(bare_list)
tc = ToolCalls([{'name': 'foo', 'args': {}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'b': 2}}])
print('9. constructed from bare list:', len(tc.tool_calls), 'calls')
assert len(tc.tool_calls) == 2

# 10. Construction path: ToolCalls(canonical dict)
tc = ToolCalls({'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {}}]})

print('11. constructed from kwarg:', tc.tool_calls[0].name)

print()
print('ALL ASSERTIONS PASSED')
